Entrata must rewrite the submitted purpose so it plainly names the property and the messages sent; compare the public sign-up form at https://baybridge.vegas with the submitted description and describe only what is visible. Do not edit the locked template ad hoc: document the mismatch, obtain the approved-template owner's change, apply it consistently, and then resubmit for carrier review. The tracker data does not provide a reliable review-time estimate.

errors.description: The campaign submission has been reviewed and rejected because the provided website does not meet validation requirements.

campaigns.actionItem: Policy is already published — it needs the text-messaging paragraph added.
campaigns.actionDetail: Tested on 2026-09-17: all 6 submitted sites loaded publicly and 6 had a reachable privacy policy, so the client does NOT need to publish a policy or unlock a website. However 6 of those policies contain no text-messaging language at all. A2P review requires the policy to state that mobile phone numbers are collected for text messages, that mobile information is not sold or shared with third parties for marketing, the expected message frequency, and that STOP ends messages and HELP gets help. Ask the client to add that paragraph to the policy they already have. Note: 6 of these policies are PDFs; reviewers prefer an HTML page, so publishing it as a web page reduces the chance of another rejection.

campaigns.actionItem: Compare the submitted website with the registered business; correct the mismatch.
campaigns.actionDetail: The reviewer checked https://chelseacollection.prospectportal.com against the legal business registered for messaging and could not validate that they belong together. Entrata must open the submitted site, compare its business name and domain with the registered legal company, and check the exact website stored in the business profile. If the submitted URL is wrong, replace it with the correct public property URL; if the business profile is wrong, correct that profile through the approved support path.
